limits: Rod axis uses the SNL23 conditional pick and inherited scale; rod diameter, length, fork profile and transverse offsets are inferred.
M314 is reused from the small-planet definition; its estimated bore establishes the matching rod tip. Source global nut quantity nine is not a transmission quantity; one belongs to this rod assembly.

Only one M308 installed here per SNL254:023; SNL221 global quantity two has a different scope. Free length38.1mm and OD17.4625mm are printed; installed height28mm, wire1.6mm and six turns are inferred.
The old clutch lugs bridge the intended fork groove. The current candidate removes their central groove band after fusion, preserving the forward station and all other clutch material.
Complete rod-to-M303 linkage, vertical shaft, two bearings, two MX11 bolt sets AND two MX12 stud sets remain pending; the outer rod hole is provisional.
Nominal thread envelopes; no load, friction-clamping, spring rate, lubrication, wear or motion qualification. Existing historical casing discrepancies and standard tank integration remain open.
A new analytic split-pin definition is used for this rod to avoid the known lost-leg behavior of older swept cotters. This does not qualify or repair unrelated historical cotter definitions.

Both M261 clutch rings share the revised tip length12.5mm, shortened2.5mm from the inherited estimate to clear the fork. Standard dog engagement remains10.85mm axially; torque capacity and future shifted poses unqualified.
